utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, you’re through to Liam at Thistle Bank. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Callum Achebe. I’d like to update the address on my account.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course, Callum. I can help with that. Before we discuss your account, could you tell me your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And could you confirm the first line of your current address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s all verified. What’s the new address you’d like us to use?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. Just to check, that’s 42 Brook Lane, Leeds, postcode LS6 2QH?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll submit the address change now. Once it’s submitted, we’ll send confirmation to your existing address, and you can check the new address in online banking after the change has been processed.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise: you’ve asked us to change your address to 42 Brook Lane, Leeds, LS6 2QH. I’ll submit the request, and you’ll receive confirmation at your current address. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, it does. Thanks for your help.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Callum. Is there anything else I can help with today?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks for calling Thistle Bank. Have a good day.
